title: Mixed-trace fusion identity for the non-spherical normalized S-matrix
difficulty_reason: The prior block monodromy and spherical partial trace are given. The new proof combines opposite quantum traces, uses Schur normalization to factor the left side, and uses the isotypic projectors to recover the nonmonoidal defect of ψ on fusion multiplicity spaces on the right. The author explicitly derives the modified coefficient from this defect trace, which is not a direct use of the spherical fusion multiplicity and remains independent of rescaling ψ.
